seeds.defect: Insufficient-balance check uses <= instead of <, so withdrawing (or transferring) the exact full balance is refused.
transfer_money records the Transaction with source and target account ids swapped, so history shows money flowing the wrong way.
TransactionRead.type labels are inverted: a transaction with no target (a withdrawal) is reported as DEPOSIT and one with no source (a deposit) as WITHDRAWAL.
find_transactions filters with date < to_date although the bound is documented as inclusive and get_summary uses <=, so list and summary disagree at the boundary.
When account_id is given, account_ids is still set to all of the client's accounts, so the account filter is ignored.
AtmBankService.withdraw_money no longer calls the amount validator (deposit_money still does), so ATM withdrawals bypass the maximum cash amount.
validate_maximum_cash_amount rejects amount >= 10000 although the rule and message say the amount may not exceed 10000, so exactly 10000 is refused.

In withdraw_money the Transaction is created after the session.begin() block has committed, so the balance change is committed but the transaction record is never committed (and is not atomic with it).
